prompt: I need to test the Composio Tool Router setup and create a mock email workflow. First, install the composio-toolrouter plugin, then run the setup process. After that, create a test script called 'email_automation.py' that demonstrates how to send an email with the subject 'Project Status Update' and body containing 'The deployment is complete and all tests are passing.' to test@example.com. The script should include proper error handling and return status confirmation. Also create a configuration file named 'composio_config.json' that stores the mock API settings with fields for api_key, base_url, and enabled_apps (which should include 'gmail').
